pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with jagged, stellate edge geometries. The pixel-level transition at patch boundaries shows a high-frequency, non-linear gradient rather than smooth curves.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous, interconnected topological graph of light-colored pathways. Junction nodes are clearly visible where three or four pathways intersect, with relatively consistent pixel thickness across the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal silhouette of the neck and shoulder exhibits a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged profile consistent with a short mane.
